mapper.insert: insert into upload_chunk (upload_id, chunk_index, chunk_size, chunk_hash) values (#{uploadId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkHash}) on duplicate key update chunk_size = #{chunkSize}, chunk_hash = #{chunkHash}
mapper.select: select chunk_index from upload_chunk where upload_id = #{uploadId} order by chunk_index asc
